{{Quote|We get the Voss and Gormak fighting again, this world is open to Czerka operations, weapon sales... the possibilities are endless!|[[Kaya Natari]]|<ref name="TOR:SotS" />}}
During the [[Third Galactic War]], [[Czerka Interstellar]] secretly '''invaded''' the planet [[Voss]] in order to break the truce between the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and [[Gormak/Legends|Gormaks]] and use a renewed war between the two species to establish its operations on the planet. However, the plot was foiled by the [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="TOR:SotS" />
